title: Italian Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and comforting Italian noodle soup made with silky noodles, nutritious vegetables, and a hint of Croatian paprika. Perfect for a cold winter evening.

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Croatian paprika adds a unique smoky flavor to the soup

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chopped onion adds a sweet and savory flavor to the soup

ingredients.name: Carrot
ingredients.notes: Chopped carrot adds a pop of color and sweetness to the soup

ingredients.name: Celery
ingredients.notes: Chopped celery adds a fresh and herbaceous flavor to the soup

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds a pungent and aromatic flavor to the soup

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.notes: Canned tomato adds a rich and tangy flavor to the soup

ingredients.name: Vegetable broth
ingredients.notes: Low-sodium vegetable broth keeps the soup light and refreshing

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Season with salt to bring out the flavors of the soup

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Add a pinch of black pepper to add depth and warmth to the soup

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery, and sauté until the vegetables are tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the canned tomato, vegetable broth, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the silky noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Add the cooked noodles to the pot and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
